The La Jolla Sky Show is the absolute BEST place to catch a 4th of July light display. We promise. ✨🇺🇸✨

Choreographed to live music and utilizing 500 state-of-the-art drones over the ocean, this is San Diego’s favorite new holiday tradition! To make sure it stays an amazing, chill experience for all our local families, let’s follow a little shoreline etiquette: 

🔦 Lights OUT: Turn your headlights completely OFF once you've parked so you don’t ruin the dark night sky for others.
🎶 Silence the stereos: Turn off your car music when the drones launch. The sky performance features its own synchronized live music, and it’s way more peaceful without multiple playlists clashing! 

😌 THANK YOU on behalf of all the San Diego families looking for a clean, eco-friendly, and breathtaking holiday experience! ✌️ 

SHOW TIMES & INFO - Mark Your Calendars! 
📆 Date: Saturday, July 4th
🕰️ Timeline: Starts promptly at 8:45 PM.
⚠️ Don’t rely on old fireworks schedules - get your spots early! Parking fills fast. 

📍 Top Recommended Viewing Spots (from our guide map): 
South Kellogg Park: Main event hub & primary public viewing. 
La Jolla Shores Beach: Front-row sandy seating right under the flight zone. 
La Jolla Cove & Surrounding Bluffs: Elevated cliff views for an incredible panoramic escape. 

👍 Always check LaJollaSkyShow.com for current updates and details! See you out there! 🌊✨
